title: Count Submatrices With All Ones
summary: Determine the count of submatrices within a binary matrix where all elements are ones.
statement: Determine the count of submatrices within a binary matrix where all elements are ones.
constraints: mat is a non-empty binary matrix.
Count every rectangular submatrix containing only ones.
hints: Convert each row into histogram heights of consecutive ones.
For every right boundary, extend left while tracking the minimum height.
That minimum is the number of all-one rectangles with this bottom and horizontal span.
Every rectangle has one bottom row and pair of horizontal boundaries, so it is counted exactly once.
editorial: Every rectangle has one bottom row and pair of horizontal boundaries, so it is counted exactly once.

tests.explanation: There are six single cells, five vertical or horizontal rectangles, and two larger rectangles, for thirteen.
Four cells, two rows, two columns, and the whole matrix give nine rectangles.
